project.name: MoLG-UNet
project.description: Modality-aware local-global U-Net for multimodal brain tumor segmentation

data_contract.label_mapping: source label 4 is mapped to region label 3 before region scoring
data_contract.training_membership_provenance: recovered from matching historical case-metrics CSV complements; it is not an original splits_final.json
data_contract.membership_policy: case identifiers and source CSVs are supplied only under the data owner's distribution permission

scientific_contract.augmentation: nnU-Net frozen augmentation and normalization pipeline
scientific_contract.planner_policy: use the supplied nnUNetPlans; do not run a new planner

no_maf.loss: standard nnU-Net region Dice+BCE with standard deep supervision
no_maf.change: replace the complete modality-aware input/stem with early-fused ConvNormAct3D(4,24)

no_swin.loss: standard nnU-Net region Dice+BCE with standard deep supervision
no_swin.change: remove the global Swin branch and corresponding fusion path while retaining the local modality-aware path and decoder

concat_fusion.loss: standard nnU-Net region Dice+BCE with standard deep supervision
concat_fusion.change: replace all five gated fusion blocks with concatenation plus 1x1 ConvNormAct3D

proposed_loss_ds_matched.loss: boundary/curvature-aware region loss plus TC distance-aware false-positive penalty

reference_implementation.status: implementation is included; the four formal experiments above are the published closeout scope

evaluation_contract.hd95_empty_rule: both empty = 0; exactly one empty or empty surface = 374 sentinel
evaluation_contract.summary: case-level mean and sample standard deviation (ddof=1); no result selection by the summary

runtime_policy.ada_profile: Torch 2.7.1+cu118, torchvision 0.22.1+cu118, Triton 3.3.1; alternative recipe requiring separate validation
runtime_policy.augmentation_workers: explicit runtime parameter; validate on the target host
runtime_policy.temporary_directory: each run uses an independent short directory under /tmp
runtime_policy.resume: same run root and checkpoint_latest.pth only; restore full nnU-Net state before continuing

historical_entries.status: retained for provenance and comparison only; not the default reproduction entry point
historical_entries.notes: contains the original federated/100-round workflow and its Dice-HD95 selection utilities
